edits.text: Before calling transfer_to_human_agents, the agent must first complete all parts of the user's request that are permitted by the policy and can be handled with the available tools.
edits.reason: This rule ensures the agent fulfills the policy requirement to handle permitted parts of a request even when other parts require transfer.

edits.text: When the user asks for the total amount paid for other upcoming reservations, the agent must call get_reservation_details for every reservation ID returned by get_user_details to verify the flight dates and retrieve the payment history for each.
edits.reason: This provides a concrete instruction for retrieving the necessary data to calculate totals for other reservations during a cancellation request.

edits.text: If the agent finds a reservation that matches the trip details provided by the user but has a different passenger name, the agent must ask the user to confirm if that is the correct reservation.
edits.reason: This prevents the agent from incorrectly assuming a reservation is missing when only a passenger name mismatch exists.

edits.text: When identifying the cheapest flight option for a user, ensure that the connection is valid by verifying that the arrival time of a flight is before the departure time of the next flight in the itinerary.
edits.reason: This ensures the agent correctly identifies valid and cheapest flight options by checking connection times.

not_adopted.reason: This proposal is superseded by a02, which provides a more concrete action for the same situation (calculating totals for other reservations).

output.summary: Added specific checks for reservation matching, flight connection validity, and multi-part request handling before transfers, and specified tool calls for calculating totals on other reservations.
